newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's CNMV lifts Fosforera share suspension.
newsitem.headline: Spain's CNMV lifts Fosforera share suspension.

text.p: Spain's national stock market commission CNMV said on Tuesday it was lifting a suspension in the trading of chemicals group Fosforera SA that had been imposed as a precautionary measure on June 12.
The CNMV said in a statement it was restoring trade in Fosforera due to "sufficient information on the circumstances that had led to the suspension".
Fosforera shares fell 51 pesetas or 15 percent, the maximum allowable drop, to 294 as soon as shares started trading again.
They had been suspended last Thursday after the company said it had suspended payments because of unfavourable market conditions and limited company resources to meet its debts.

Fosferera said in a statement to the CNMV at the time that it had succeeded in reducing the group's financial debt by more than nine billion pesetas as a result of a thorough financial restructuring in the last two years.
